thesis: At age 41, LeBron James continues to defy aging curves in professional basketball, averaging career-defining scoring numbers while extending his all-time record lead and remaining competitive in playoff competition.

facts.claim: LeBron James averaged 20.9 points per game at age 41, breaking the previous age-41 scoring record held by another player who averaged 10.1.
James holds the records for most points per game at ages 37, 38, 39, 40 and 41, established over consecutive seasons starting in the 2021-22 season.
In the 2026 postseason, LeBron averaged 23.2 points, 7.3 assists and 6.7 rebounds, leading the Lakers to upset the Houston Rockets in the first round.
James is the only player in NBA history with 50,000 combined regular-season and playoff points, currently at 51,729 total career points.
LeBron surpassed Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's all-time scoring record on February 7, 2023, and has since extended his lead to 43,440 regular-season career points.
Only three players in NBA history have played significant regular-season minutes at age 42, which LeBron James will do in the 2026-27 season barring injury.
